memes.description_tl: Si Oprah na naka-red outfit, may hawak na mikropono at nakabuka ang mga braso habang excited na sumisigaw. Gamit ito sa “lahat meron!” moments—pamimigay ng regalo, bonus, o kahit dagdag trabaho sa buong team.
memes.description_en: Oprah wears a red outfit, holding a microphone with her arms spread wide as she excitedly shouts. Used for “everyone gets one!” moments—handing out gifts, bonuses, or even extra work to the whole team.

memes.description_tl: Dalawang pulang button ang pagpipilian ng isang lalaking pawis na pawis at nagpupunas ng noo, na parang hirap magdesisyon. Ginagamit ito kapag parehong mahirap, tempting, o magkasalungat ang dalawang choice mo.
memes.description_en: A sweating man wipes his forehead while faced with two red buttons, visibly struggling to decide. Used when both choices are difficult, tempting, or contradictory.

memes.description_tl: Dalawang-panel na Drake meme: sa taas, umiiwas siya at nakataas ang kamay bilang pagtanggi; sa baba, nakangiti siyang nagtuturo bilang pagsang-ayon. Ginagamit ito para ikumpara ang ayaw mo sa mas bet mong choice, gaya ng trabaho versus pahinga o gastos versus ipon.
memes.description_en: A two-panel Drake meme: on top, he turns away with his hand raised in rejection; below, he smiles and points in approval. It is used to compare something you dislike with a preferred choice, such as work versus rest or spending versus saving.

memes.description_tl: Dalawang blankong papel ang ipinapakompara sa office, tapos sabi ni Pam sa The Office, “They're the same picture.” Ginagamit ito kapag dalawang bagay, tao, o sitwasyon ay kunwari magkaiba pero pareho lang naman talaga.
memes.description_en: Two blank sheets are presented for comparison in an office, then Pam from The Office says, “They're the same picture.” Used when two things, people, or situations supposedly differ but are really the same.
memes.ocr_text:
Corporate needs you to find the differences
between this picture and this picture.
They're the same picture.

memes.description_tl: Close-up ng lalaking may bigote at goatee na may caption na “Now you know!” Pang-react kapag may bagong nalaman, may na-explain kang trivia, o gusto mong sabihing “ayan, alam mo na.”
memes.description_en: A close-up of a man with a mustache and goatee, captioned “Now you know!” Used when someone learns something new, after explaining trivia, or to say “there, now you know.”

memes.description_tl: Isang babaeng naka-earphones ang nakahawak sa magkabilang gilid ng ulo, nakakunot ang noo at mukhang litong-lito o stressed. Pang-reaction kapag hindi mo na gets ang lesson, ang daming problema, o may narinig kang nakakagulong balita.
memes.description_en: A woman wearing earphones holds both sides of her head, frowning and looking confused or stressed. Used as a reaction when you cannot understand a lesson, have too many problems, or hear something bewildering.

memes.description_tl: Isang cartoon na aso ang kalmadong nakaupo at may kape habang nasusunog ang buong kuwarto, sabay sabing “This is fine.” Ginagamit kapag kunwari okay ka lang kahit tambak ang problema, deadlines, o stress at parang nagkakagulo na ang lahat.
memes.description_en: A cartoon dog calmly sits with coffee while the whole room burns, saying “This is fine.” Used when pretending everything is okay despite mounting problems, deadlines, or stress and everything falling apart.

memes.description_tl: Four-panel na Gru's Plan meme kung saan confident na nagpe-present si Gru sa blankong board, tapos napatingin siya rito na parang may mali sa plano. Ginagamit kapag akala mo solid ang diskarte mo sa school, trabaho, o buhay pero biglang napansin mong sablay pala.
memes.description_en: A four-panel Gru's Plan meme showing Gru confidently presenting beside a blank board, then looking back at it as if something is wrong with his plan. Used when you think your school, work, or life strategy is solid but suddenly realize it has a flaw.

memes.description_tl: Isang lalaking naka-white shirt ang nakaharap sa camera na nakakunot ang noo at seryoso, parang hindi impressed. Bagay ito sa reaction na badtrip, duda, o walang gana sa sinasabi ng kausap.
memes.description_en: A man in a white shirt faces the camera with a furrowed brow and a serious, unimpressed expression. It fits reactions of annoyance, skepticism, or disinterest in what someone is saying.

memes.description_tl: Isang office worker ang gulat at problemadong nakatitig sa cellphone habang nakahawak sa noo. Sakto kapag chineck mo ang e-wallet at ubos na pala ang sweldo, pero malayo pa ang susunod na payday.
memes.description_en: An office worker stares at his phone in shock and worry, holding his forehead. Perfect for checking your e-wallet and realizing your salary is already gone while the next payday is still far away.

memes.description_tl: Lumingon ang boyfriend sa babaeng naka-red habang ang kasama niyang girlfriend ay nakatingin sa kanya na gulat at badtrip. Ginagamit ito kapag natutukso sa bagong option at napapabayaan ang kasalukuyang jowa, gawain, o responsibilidad.
memes.description_en: A boyfriend turns to look at a woman in red while his girlfriend looks at him in shock and annoyance. Used when someone is tempted by a new option and neglects their current partner, task, or responsibility.

memes.description_tl: Isang kalbong lalaki ang nakatingin sa camera na may bahagyang ngiti, habang may isa pang lalaki sa likod niya. Bagay itong reaction kapag may banat ang tropa at ang sagot mo ay isang tahimik na tinging parang “talaga ba?”
memes.description_en: A bald man looks at the camera with a slight smile while another man stands behind him. It works as a reaction when a friend makes a remark and you respond with a silent “really?” look.

memes.description_tl: Si Boromir sa The Lord of the Rings, nakataas ang kamay na parang seryosong nagpapaliwanag na hindi basta-basta ang isang bagay. Gamit ang “One Does Not Simply” meme kapag may gawaing akala ng iba madali pero mahirap pala, gaya ng pag-iipon o pag-move on.
memes.description_en: Boromir from The Lord of the Rings raises his hand as if seriously explaining that something is not that simple. The “One Does Not Simply” meme is used for tasks others assume are easy but are actually difficult, like saving money or moving on.

memes.description_tl: Si Bernie Sanders na naka-winter jacket sa labas, may caption na “I am once again asking.” Ginagamit kapag paulit-ulit kang humihingi ng tulong, suporta, pabor, o ambag sa barkada.
memes.description_en: Bernie Sanders stands outdoors in a winter jacket with the caption “I am once again asking.” Used when repeatedly asking for help, support, favors, or contributions from friends.
memes.ocr_text:
Bernie
I am once again asking

memes.description_tl: Isang kalansay ang nakaupo sa bench, parang inabot na ng habambuhay sa paghihintay. Pang-meme kapag sobrang tagal ng reply, pila, sweldo, o pagdating ng kausap mo.
memes.description_en: A skeleton sits on a bench as if it has spent a lifetime waiting. Used when a reply, a queue, payday, or someone's arrival is taking forever.

memes.description_tl: Si Lenny sa The Simpsons ay naglalagay ng zero sa “days without” board, kaya balik sa zero ang bilang ng araw na walang insidente. Gamit ito kapag naulit na naman ang bisyo, pagkakamali, o aberyang sinusubukang iwasan.
memes.description_en: Lenny from The Simpsons puts a zero on a “days without” board, resetting the incident-free count to zero. Use it when a bad habit, mistake, or recurring problem happens yet again.

memes.description_tl: Ang lalaki sa Ancient Aliens meme ay nakangiti at nakataas ang dalawang kamay na parang nagpapaliwanag ng kakaibang teorya. Ginagamit ito kapag may absurd na paliwanag, conspiracy theory, o sinisisi na lang sa aliens ang bagay na hindi maipaliwanag.
memes.description_en: The man in the Ancient Aliens meme is smiling with both hands raised as if explaining an unusual theory. It is used for absurd explanations, conspiracy theories, or blaming aliens for something unexplained.

memes.description_tl: Magkatabi ang sobrang maskuladong Buff Doge at ang maliit, nakaupong Cheems na mukhang malungkot at may luha. Ginagamit ito pang-compare ng malakas at mahinang version ng sarili, gaya ng confident bago ang exam pero kawawa na pagdating sa actual test.
memes.description_en: An extremely muscular Buff Doge stands beside a smaller, seated Cheems who looks sad and teary. This meme compares strong and weak versions of yourself, such as feeling confident before an exam but helpless during the actual test.

memes.description_tl: Drawing ng dalawang maskuladong braso na mahigpit na nag-handshake, gaya ng Epic Handshake meme. Ginagamit kapag may solid na pagkakasundo, teamwork, o magkaibang grupo na may iisang hilig o problema.
memes.description_en: A drawing of two muscular arms clasping hands in the Epic Handshake pose. Used for strong agreement, teamwork, or different groups sharing the same interest or problem.

memes.description_tl: May blue flag icon at text na “Marked Safe From” at “Today,” na may bakanteng espasyo para sa kung anong naiwasan. Ginagamit ito para pabirong sabihing ligtas ka o nakaiwas sa hassle, drama, gastos, o ibang problema ngayong araw.
memes.description_en: A blue flag icon appears above “Marked Safe From” and “Today,” with blank space for whatever was avoided. It is used to jokingly announce that you are safe from hassles, drama, spending, or other problems for the day.

memes.description_tl: Isang basang commuter ang nakatayo sa ulan, may sirang payong sa tabi habang may jeepney sa kalsada. Pang-mood kapag malas ang commute: pagod ka na, late pa, at bumigay pa ang payong.
memes.description_en: A drenched commuter stands in the rain beside a broken umbrella while a jeepney is on the road. It captures an unlucky commute when you're already tired, running late, and even your umbrella gives up.

memes.description_tl: Isang lalaking naka-bonnet ang humahawak sa leeg habang mukhang sabik na may hinihingi pa—ang classic na “Y’all got any more of that?” meme. Ginagamit kapag bitin at gusto mo pa ng kape, sweldo, pagkain, o bagong episode.
memes.description_en: A man wearing a beanie holds his neck while looking eager to ask for more—the classic “Y’all got any more of that?” meme. Used when you cannot get enough and want more coffee, pay, food, or new episodes.

memes.description_tl: Dalawang panel ng UNO meme: isang card na may “OR draw 25,” at isang lalaking may hawak na maraming baraha. Ginagamit kapag mas pipiliin mong maparusahan o mahirapan kaysa gawin ang isang ayaw mong task o aminin ang isang bagay.
memes.description_en: A two-panel UNO meme shows a card reading “OR draw 25” and a man holding a large hand of cards. It is used when you would rather accept a penalty or hardship than do an unwanted task or admit something.

memes.description_tl: Isang titang nakaupo sa hapag, humihigop ng kape habang nakataas ang kilay at may mapanghusgang side-eye. Bagay sa chismis, pagiging Marites, o tahimik na pangja-judge sa mga kuwento sa family reunion.
memes.description_en: An auntie sits at a dining table, sipping coffee with a raised eyebrow and a judgmental side-eye. Useful for gossip, nosiness, or silently judging stories at a family reunion.

memes.description_tl: Si Bernie Sanders na naka-winter jacket at salamin, nakaharap sa camera na parang seryosong nakikiusap. Ginagamit ito kapag paulit-ulit kang humihingi ng tulong, pabor, o ambag, o nagpapaalala na naman sa mga kaibigan at katrabaho.
memes.description_en: Bernie Sanders wears a winter jacket and glasses, facing the camera as if making a serious appeal. This meme is used when repeatedly asking for help, favors, or contributions, or reminding friends and coworkers yet again.

memes.description_tl: Isang AI-generated na driver ang nakasimangot at mahigpit ang kapit sa manibela habang stuck sa traffic sa EDSA. Pang-react kapag badtrip ka na sa usad-pagong na biyahe, lalo na sa rush hour at gusto mo nang makauwi.
memes.description_en: An AI-generated driver scowls and grips the steering wheel while stuck in EDSA traffic. Used when you're fed up with a painfully slow trip, especially during rush hour when you just want to get home.

memes.description_tl: Blank na Expanding Brain meme na may apat na panel ng utak na palaki nang palaki ang glow, mula ordinaryong isip hanggang sa sobrang enlightened. Ginagamit ito para ikumpara ang mga ideya o diskarte mula basic hanggang kunwari galaxy-brain, madalas sarcastic o lalong sablay.
memes.description_en: A blank Expanding Brain meme with four panels showing brains glowing progressively brighter, from ordinary thinking to extreme enlightenment. It is used to compare ideas or strategies from basic to supposedly galaxy-brain, often sarcastically or with increasingly absurd choices.

memes.description_tl: Si Squidward ay nakasilip sa bintana habang masayang naglalaro sa labas sina SpongeBob at Patrick. Ginagamit ito kapag inggit o feeling left out ka, lalo na kung nasa bahay o trabaho ka habang gumagala ang barkada.
memes.description_en: Squidward looks through his window while SpongeBob and Patrick happily play outside. Used when you feel envious or left out, especially when you're stuck at home or work while your friends are out having fun.

memes.description_tl: Dalawang astronaut ang nakatingin sa Earth, pero ang nasa likod ay nakatutok ng baril sa kasama niya—ang “Always Has Been” meme. Ginagamit kapag may bagong realization ka, tapos malalaman mong matagal na palang ganoon at ikaw lang ang huling nakaalam.
memes.description_en: Two astronauts look at Earth, but the one behind points a gun at the other—the “Always Has Been” meme. Used when you discover something only to learn it has always been that way and you were the last to know.

memes.description_tl: Black-and-white na larawan ni Martin Scorsese na nakaupo at nakataas ang dalawang kamay, mula sa “Absolute Cinema” meme. Ginagamit kapag sobrang ganda o epic ng eksena, plot twist, o drama—puwede ring sarcastic reaction sa kalokohang pang-pelikula.
memes.description_en: A black-and-white photo of Martin Scorsese seated with both hands raised, from the “Absolute Cinema” meme. Used to praise an amazing scene, plot twist, or drama—or sarcastically react to movie-worthy absurdity.

memes.description_tl: Isang asul na kotse ang biglang kumakabig papunta sa exit ramp sa halip na dumiretso sa highway. Ginagamit ito kapag biglang nagbago ng plano, nagpadala sa tukso, o pinili ang detour kaysa sa dapat gawin.
memes.description_en: A blue car swerves sharply onto an exit ramp instead of continuing straight on the highway. It is used for abruptly changing plans, giving in to temptation, or choosing a detour over what you should be doing.

memes.description_tl: Tatlong eksena ni Pablo Escobar na mag-isang nakaupo sa swing, nasa hapag-kainan, at nakatayo sa tabi ng walang lamang pool. Pang-meme kapag malungkot, lonely, o bored ka habang naghihintay ng reply o walang makasama.
memes.description_en: Three scenes of Pablo Escobar alone on a swing, at a dining table, and standing beside an empty pool. Used when feeling sad, lonely, or bored while waiting for a reply or having no one to hang out with.

memes.description_tl: Lalaking naka-suit na magkadikit ang mga daliri sa ilalim ng “Trade Offer,” na may bakanteng “i receive” at “you receive.” Ginagamit kapag may tawaran, deal, o pabor na kunwari patas pero lugi ang isang panig.
memes.description_en: A man in a suit holds his fingertips together beneath “Trade Offer,” with blank “i receive” and “you receive” sections. Used for bargaining, deals, or favors that supposedly benefit both sides but leave one side worse off.

memes.description_tl: Si Buzz Lightyear ay nakaakbay kay Woody at nakaturo sa paligid, habang mukhang alanganin si Woody. Gamit ang “X, X Everywhere” meme kapag puro iisang bagay ang nakikita mo—gaya ng deadlines, gastos, o problema kahit saan.
memes.description_en: Buzz Lightyear has an arm around Woody and gestures around them while Woody looks uneasy. The “X, X Everywhere” meme is used when the same thing seems to be everywhere, such as deadlines, expenses, or problems.

memes.description_tl: Isang mukhang puyat at lutang na office worker ang nakaupo sa harap ng computer, hawak ang malaking mug ng kape. Pang-Monday morning na antok at pagod ka pa pero kailangan nang magtrabaho.
memes.description_en: An exhausted, spaced-out office worker sits at a computer holding a large mug of coffee. Used for Monday mornings when you are still sleepy and tired but have to work.

memes.description_tl: Dalawang-panel na cartoon ng taong inaabot ang dilaw na balloon, pero pinipigilan siya ng pink na character na nakahawak sa kanya mula sa likod. Ginagamit ito kapag may gusto kang maabot—goals, pahinga, o kalayaan—pero may responsibilidad o ibang humahadlang.
memes.description_en: A two-panel cartoon shows a person reaching for a yellow balloon while a pink character holds them back from behind. It is used when you want to reach something—goals, rest, or freedom—but responsibilities or other obstacles keep you from it.

memes.description_tl: Dalawang panel ni Dad na proud na itinuturo ang bakanteng patungan ng trophy, tapos biglang nagagalit dahil wala naman siyang trophy. Pang-react kapag may nakahanda ka nang paglalagyan o plano para sa achievement, jowa, o sweldo—kung meron lang sana.
memes.description_en: Two panels show Dad proudly presenting an empty trophy pedestal, then getting angry because he has no trophy. Used when you already have a place or plans for an achievement, partner, or paycheck—if only you actually had one.

memes.description_tl: Four-panel meme nina Anakin at Padmé sa damuhan: nakangiti si Padmé sa umpisa, pero naging alanganin ang mukha niya habang seryoso lang si Anakin. Ginagamit kapag akala mo harmless ang sinabi ng kausap, tapos mapapa-“joke lang ’yon, di ba?” ka.
memes.description_en: A four-panel meme of Anakin and Padmé in a meadow: Padmé starts out smiling but grows uneasy while Anakin remains serious. Used when you initially assume someone's statement is harmless, then find yourself asking, “You're joking, right?”

memes.description_tl: Isang lalaking naka-suit ang nagmamadaling pumasok sa opisina, may hawak na kape at laptop at mukhang taranta. Bagay ito kapag late ka na sa standup o meeting, lalo na sa Monday na sabog ang simula ng trabaho.
memes.description_en: A man in a suit rushes into the office holding coffee and a laptop, looking flustered. Use it when you're running late to a standup or meeting, especially during a chaotic Monday morning.

memes.description_tl: Si SpongeBob ay nakayuko, nakadilat nang malaki, at naka-awkward na pose na parang nanggagaya para mang-asar. Ginagamit ito pang-mock ng sinabi ng iba, lalo na sa palusot, reklamo, o pabidang comment, madalas may salit-salitang uppercase at lowercase na caption.
memes.description_en: SpongeBob is hunched over with wide eyes and an awkward pose, as if imitating someone to tease them. People use this meme to mock someone's excuses, complaints, or know-it-all comments, often with alternating uppercase and lowercase captions.
